* Game text: At the end of any player's draw phase, cause that player to place Used Pile face up on top of Reserve Deck. Shuffle, cut, and replace. When face-up cards are removed from Reserve Deck, they are treated as normal (no longer remain face up).
* Players may ''not'' look through the Reserve Deck to see where the cards are. A judge may be requested to count the Reserve Deck.
* Player may activate Force 1 at a time, look at the top card of Reserve Deck, and stop activating based on what they see.
